text:
PagerBot: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-88324|INCIDENT: inference-eu-5xx-high> page fired for service inference-eu (severity: P1). count=1240 in last 2m, spike in 5xx from 0.2% -> 12.3%. auto-notify: @oncall.

Priya (oncall): acked. I'm on it. pulling the runbook.

Evan: thx — are we seeing KV-cache evictions again or a downstream DB?

Jun: looks like 502/504 pattern, mostly worker pool 4 and 7. quick sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:03:21Z service=inference-eu host=worker-7 req_id=abc123 status=502 err="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-15T10:03:26Z service=inference-eu host=worker-4 req_id=def456 status=504 err="connection reset"
```

Priya (oncall): running the mitigation checklist. increasing autoscaler maxReplicas temporarily, and toggling fallback-route to dedicated-pool.

SRE Bot: autoscaler scale-up started -> requested to 60 replicas. fallback-route: enabled -> routing 15% traffic to dedicated-pool-eu. Runbook: <https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike>

Evan: posted a quick command to force-bounce unhealthy pods:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/worker-pool-4
kubectl -n inference delete pod worker-7-*
``` 

Jun: customer impact summary: 3 enterprise tenants affected (acme-co, travelly, shoplane). estimated failed requests = ~8% of their traffic in last 10m. notified SRE that Customer Success may need to send templated update.

Marta: @Priya I'll be on shift in 20m, happy to take over if this persists. can you DM any sticky state info? :eyes:

Priya (oncall): @Marta will DM the rolling logs and the spike window. current plan: keep autoscaler up, monitor 5xx rate, rollback routing after steady state. ETA for stable: 18 minutes.

Carlos: re: dedicated-pool — remember to increase qps threshold before routing more traffic. dropping into ops channel now to bump quotas.

Priya (oncall): status ping: 10:12 UTC — 5xx rate down to 3.1%, request latency normalizing. holding actions for 10m.

Evan: :thumbsup: looks like bounce worked on worker-7. any errors left in logs?

Jun: minor 504s still from worker-4 but decreasing. will tail for 15m. saving log slice to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-3830012345/logs.tar.gz

PagerBot: Reminder: if no ack transfer in 30m, autopromote to next rotation. autoreminder in 10m.

SRE Bot: creating incident summary ticket: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OPS-5509

Priya (oncall): final update for now — customer impact mitigated, CS notified, handing to @Marta when she clocks in. marking as acknowledged and in-monitoring. :white_check_mark:

Marta: copied. Will take over monitoring and will update if anything regresses. thanks everyone.
